title: Collision and proximity beep alerts
summary: The sampled fragments describe the vehicle emitting beep alerts for collision risk or when approaching an object, without enough context to determine sentiment.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments mention beep warnings for collision risk and nearby objects but do not state whether owners viewed this behavior favorably or unfavorably.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so sentiment cannot be inferred from this topic.
The examples are very short and provide limited context about when the beep occurs or how reviewers evaluated it.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 reviews.
